outcomes.title: Probabilistic multi-sensor field-state diagnosis method
outcomes.description: A calibrated probabilistic method (and its software implementation) that fuses radar, optical (Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2), secured PlanetScope, meteorological (ERA5) and field-observation data into posterior estimates of the latent field state (root-zone soil moisture and crop water status), via Route B (the homogeneous-patch proxy, RQ2), within an architecture that also defines Route A (direct probabilistic fusion) as an alternative.
outcomes.exploitation_route: Open research software and methods; peer-reviewed publication; contribution to the standalone research demonstrator. Field validation is provided through the host (ELTE) and the associated partner AgroVIR (Hungarian tomato farms).

outcomes.title: Uncertainty-aware AquaCrop decision engine
outcomes.description: An integrated decision engine that calibrates AquaCrop while retaining an honest parameter posterior, runs counterfactual irrigation simulations over weather ensembles, and recommends the option that best improves water-use efficiency (WUE, RQ6).
outcomes.exploitation_route: Open research software; publication; integration into the demonstrator. Downstream operational exploitation is supported by the host (ELTE) and the associated partner AgroVIR.
outcomes.note: The uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration is the project's vault-grounded methodology; it is not attributed to the fellow.

outcomes.title: Field-validation dataset and uncertainty-calibration evidence
outcomes.description: A validation dataset (non-destructive physiological ground truth - chlorophyll fluorescence, stomatal conductance, canopy/leaf temperature, spectral reflectance - and sensor comparison) and calibration evidence establishing whether the diagnosis and decision recommendations are credible and whether reported uncertainty is well calibrated (90% prediction-interval coverage, RQ5), including a test of Route B's patch-covariation assumption (RQ9).
outcomes.exploitation_route: Open validation data and protocol; publication. Validation sites are Hungarian tomato farms accessed via the associated partner AgroVIR; ground truth is non-destructive physiological measurement (RQ4).

outcomes.title: Standalone research demonstrator (web MVP)
outcomes.description: An end-to-end demonstrator presenting irrigation recommendations with their uncertainty, integrating the diagnosis and decision engine as a research artefact.
outcomes.exploitation_route: Standalone research demonstrator with the associated partner AgroVIR assisting (feedback, farmer access, testing) rather than owning or operating it. TRL target: research prototype, TRL 3-4 (RQ10).
source_vault_nodes: Web MVP and User Interface Layer (METH-INFRA-010)
outcomes.note: Demonstrator framing is vault synthesis (Web MVP node confidence low), hence Inferred; partners assist rather than own (prompt.txt §8). TRL target resolved to research prototype, TRL 3-4 (RQ10).

outcomes.title: Peer-reviewed publications and open science outputs
outcomes.description: Open-access publications, open research data and open models covering the probabilistic-fusion diagnosis, the uncertainty-aware decision engine and the validation, with a Data Management Plan delivered by month 6 (MSCA open-science requirement, sub-section 1.2).
outcomes.exploitation_route: Open-access dissemination; open data/models under FAIR principles. Specific venues are not asserted and are refined with the host.
source_vault_nodes: State of the Art - Multi Sensor Crop Water Stress Monitoring (METH-SOTA-001)
outcomes.note: Open-science posture is an MSCA-PF structural requirement (sub-section 1.2) combined with the vault's demonstrator/novelty framing; no specific venues or publication counts are invented.

outcomes.title: Enhanced researcher competences and career readiness
outcomes.description: The fellow's advanced scientific, technical and transferable skills and enhanced career perspectives resulting from the fellowship's training, supervision and two-way transfer of knowledge - the fellow's plant-physiology and non-destructive stress-phenotyping expertise exchanged for the host's geoinformatics, remote-sensing and hyperspectral/multisensor-fusion competence.
outcomes.exploitation_route: The fellow's enhanced competences are exploited through: (i) research leadership on uncertainty-aware crop-water decision support at the host and, on return, in the fellow's home research ecosystem; (ii) peer-reviewed publication and the open release of the decision-support demonstrator; and (iii) two-way transfer between the fellow's plant-physiology / non-destructive-phenotyping expertise and the host's geoinformatics and remote-sensing methods. Specific quantitative targets are not asserted (none operator-provided) and are to be set in the Career Development Plan with the supervisor.
